issue_request: FHIR-17495 was Published/Persuasive for STU3 and requested an Observation reagent extension with cardinality 0..* and value Reference(Substance) for reagents/substances used to generate a laboratory observation.
initial_application: The issue was originally applied in core by commit 93900ade91, which updated the Observation extension spreadsheet entry for Reagent to use Reference(Substance) and the approved in-lab LIS wording.
additional_context: Core commit dd468d4f17 later removed observation-reagent and other resource extension definitions from the R5 core source/Observation implementation guide as part of moving standard extensions out of core. The FHIR Extension Pack repository describes itself as the separate specification for standard extensions referenced by core and currently contains the active StructureDefinition/observation-reagent definition. Core retains the canonical OID registry entry in source/oids.ini.
reconciliation: No FHIR core source change was made. The published audit commit records that the current source of truth for the requested extension is HL7/fhir-extensions, where the definition already has Observation context, max *, and value Reference(Substance).
